Connect your account. Keep your space.
Connect and manage your sign-in
Connection is not configured in this build. You can still explore the preview and organize your library without signing in.
Your bots, closer.

BotOS is an independent app that uses Telegram. With your consent it connects directly to your account to show messages from the bots you choose. Your session stays on this device so you can return later.
I agree to connect my account and keep my session on this device.

Enter the password you set for Telegram. It will not be saved here.
